specialty_focus: MED-SELL.COM (often referred to as MedSell ) is a healthcare asset management company specializing in the acquisition, trade, and white-glove disposition of pre-owned and surplus medical equipment . It helps clinics and hospitals turn unused or outdated inventory into capital. Business Wire Depending on regional context, "MedSell" or "MediSell" may also refer to localized European medical device distributors or mobile device marketplaces.
